name: Sample for Helbrim
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
A colleague in Kalimdor, Apothecary Helbrim, is researching the effects of Lordaeron toxins on the beasts of Kalimdor.  He would be very interested in a sample of the wolf hearts Renferrel sent me.

Helbrim is stationed in the Barrens, in a village known as the Crossroads.  To reach him, you must travel via zeppelin to the orc capital of Orgrimmar, then travel south, by foot, to Durotar.  Head west into the Barrens, and you will soon reach the Crossroads.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Wolf Heart Sample to Apothecary Helbrim in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, very good. If initial reports are true, then the toxicity of these hearts could lead to further advances in our knowledge of poisons.

This is a welcome delivery, adventurer. Your reward is well earned.
narrative.requestItemsText: You have a package for me?
